reviews.title: Ameliorer l’utilisation
reviews.text: L’apps a l’aire d’être chouette mais impossible de l’utiliser sans que ca se centralise sur le territoire français. Des qu’on fait une recherche pour un autre pays ca nous remet directement en France…

reviews.title: Has potential, but needs language settings
reviews.text: I could not find any way to change the user interface language from French to English - and also other settings were apparently France-centric (like the “Crit’Air” vignette), but had no counterpart for other countries. Will uninstall it now, but may check back later if they manage to fix these issues).
